subject: Token economics breakout — follow-up & next steps
messages:
From: Carly Nguyen <carly.nguyen@healthwave.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@healthwave.io>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 17:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + token economics call — quick recap

Thanks for the call earlier, Vanessa. Quick recap from our side:

- We're building an AI triage assistant for patient intake (MVP). Initial scope: 4 core features (symptom intake, triage score, referral suggestion, intake summary).
- Expected user volume: 50k unique patients/month; average 6 prompts per patient (some short, some long).
- Estimated token mix: ~10% long (>=1000 tokens), 70% medium (200-1000), 20% short (<200).
- Target budget: mid-six figures annually. We need a rough target cost per 1M tokens that maps to an annual inference spend we can model for procurement.

Action items for Redwood: provide a $/1M token target that supports our margin assumptions, and a sketch of CAC payback with your recommended pricing tier. Also would like a draft SOW we can share with procurement.

Thanks,
Carly Nguyen
Head of Product, HealthWave

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Carly Nguyen <carly.nguyen@healthwave.io>, Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@healthwave.io>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + token economics call — quick recap

Carly — really helpful notes, thanks. Looping Rafael and Neha (cc later) for pricing & SOW.

At a high level (very rough, based on the distribution you gave):
- Ballpark token volume: 50k users * 6 prompts * est. 800 avg tokens = ~240M tokens/month (this is a conservative mid estimate; long prompts will raise the avg).
- Cost targets: to map to mid-six figure annual inference spend, you are roughly targeting $x to $y per 1M tokens (I'll put a concrete range after Rafael chimes in).
- Unit economics for the product: we sketched a $/feature metric during the call — important to understand ARR per feature and target contribution margin.

I'm attaching a simple workbook with two scenarios (conservative / aggressive) for token volumes — HealthWave_MVP_token_estimates.xlsx. Rafael — can you confirm a recommended $/1M token target we can show procurement that achieves ~50-60% contribution margin at the feature level? Also, can you prepare a one-page SOW draft?

Next steps we suggested on the call:
1) Redwood to provide $/1M token scenarios + SOW draft (by EOD your time).
2) HealthWave to share a brief procurement checklist and any required compliance evidence (SOC2/HIPAA specifics).
3) 30-minute follow-up with procurement + engineering next Wed to align on rollout milestones.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + token economics call — follow-up pricing scaffold

Vanessa / Neha — pulled a few scenarios and assumptions into the workbook (attached). Key assumptions I used:

- Avg tokens per prompt: conservative 400, expected 800, aggressive 1200.
- Tokens per month: 96M (conservative) / 240M (expected) / 360M (aggressive).
- Model mix: 60% efficient quantized base for short/medium, 40% higher-quality variant for long prompts.
- Redwood hosted list pricing (baseline) maps to ~$120 per 1M tokens for the efficient profile and ~$350 per 1M for the high-quality variant. With committed volumes (quarterly reserved), we can offer blended rates ~ $70–150 per 1M depending on term & commitment.

For HealthWave target margins at the feature level:
- If you price each feature (per month active user) to yield $X ARR per feature per user, hitting 50–60% contribution margin requires inference cost roughly <= 10–15% of that ARR.

Concrete example (expected scenario):
- Monthly tokens: 240M -> ~2.88B tokens/year.
- Blended inference cost at $100 per 1M = $288k/year.
- If HealthWave targets $12 ARR per MAU for the bundle of those features, and 50k MAU -> revenue = $7.2M ARR.
- Inference as % of ARR = 4% (good margin headroom). Even at $200 per 1M = $576k/year -> 8% of ARR.

CAC payback: assume CAC = $250 per new customer (marketing + sales), average revenue per customer first 12 months = $144 (12 * $12) -> immediate negative payback in that simplistic model. You mentioned CAC would be higher; if your CAC is $600, payback at current pricing stretches > 1 year.

Notes / asks for HealthWave:
- Confirm target ARPU per user (monthly) so we can reverse engineer acceptable $/1M token.
- Confirm whether you expect to migrate long prompts to a cheaper batch/baseline path (prefix caching) — this materially reduces token cost.

I also dropped a draft SOW (Redwood_SOW-v0.2.docx) in attachments.

Rafael
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + token economics call — consolidated numbers + ask

Carly / Luis — Rafael's scenarios attached; pulled the most procurement-friendly bullets below so you can forward internally.

Summary bullets you can share with procurement (one-pager style):
- Estimated annual tokens (expected): ~2.88B tokens/year (240M/month).
- Proposal: Blended reserved pricing target = $90 per 1M tokens (12‑month commitment + quarterly ramp).
- Expected inference annual cost at $90/1M = ~$260k.
- If HealthWave realizes $12 ARR per MAU across the bundled features and 50k MAU -> revenue = $7.2M -> inference % of ARR = ~3.6% at $90/1M.
- Contribution margin target: We recommend designing pricing such that inference is <= 10% of feature-level contribution margin targets to leave room for engineering and CDN costs.

CAC payback examples (simplified):
- Scenario A: CAC = $400, ARPU = $12/mo -> payback = ~33 months (if only first-year revenue counted).
- Scenario B: If ARPU can be increased to $20/mo via add-on features, payback drops below 2 years.

Ask for HealthWave procurement: please confirm target ARPU or acceptable inference % of ARR (e.g., 5% target). Also confirm whether a 12-month committed path is acceptable; it unlocks the blended $90/1M level.

Next step: 30-min procurement sync on Wed 10/13. Confirm times that work for you and we’ll send a calendar invite + brief agenda.

Attachments: HealthWave_MVP_token_estimates.xlsx; Redwood_SOW-v0.2.docx

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
